content.title: EmilBanca Gametour
content.descr: An *interactive quiz experience*, centered around exploring places of interest throught the Emilia region. Visit towns and natural landmarks, and answer questions about them to get rewards.

content.title: Backstage - Tutti in Scena
content.descr: A card game where you collect resources and stack effects with special cards to get cheers for your stage play - made as part of a larger teaching platform about theatre.

content.title: FRAGORE
content.descr: An *interactive quiz experience* where you explore the town of Lugo to answer trivia questions and play minigames, all centered around three key figures from the city's history.

content.title: Judikes
content.descr: A *companion webapp* for an educational board game about the history of Sardinian churches and Medieval Sardinia in general.
